Sub. : Submission of Audio Recording of post conference call on Un-audited Financial 
Results (Standalone & Consolidated) on Q1FY27 (2026-27).  
 
Ref.: Reg. 30 read with Schedule III & all other applicable Regulations, if any, of the SEBI 
(LODR) Regulations, 2015, (Listing Regulations) as amended from time to time. 
______________________________________________________________________  
 
Dear Sir / Madam, 
 
Kindly refer our letter no. SEC/1507/2026 dtd. July 15, 2026, wherein we notified the Exchanges 
regarding the schedule for the conference call to discuss the Q1FY27 results, which took place on 
Friday, July 24, 2026. Pursuant to Regulation 30(6) of Listing Regulations, the audio recordings of the 
conference call on the Un-audited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) of the Company for 
Q1FY27 Results made on July 24, 2026 is available on the website of the Company.  
 
Link to access above audio recording is as under: 
 
https://apar.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Apar-Industries-Q1FY27-Earnings-Call-Audio.mp3 
 
 
We request you to take the above on your record. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For APAR Industries Limited 
 
 
 
(Sanjaya Kunder) 
Company Secretary
